title: Primitive recursiveness of binary bit appending
statement: The operation that takes a Boolean bit $b$ and a natural number $n$ to $2n+b$ is primitive recursive.
replaced:
The two-argument operation taking a Boolean bit $b$ and a natural number $n$ to
$2n + b$, i.e.\ appending $b$ as a new least-significant binary digit, is primitive
recursive.
